about_the_game:
Features the complete soundtrack—including hidden tracks—from Onyx DreamMaker’s latest underground fantasy RPG game experience. Themes of longing, love and gratitude for love infuse the instrumental-only tracks.

"I love how it skates through eerie and goofy and genuinely quite pretty so well. Very distinctive. Fave tracks are 'Tal Alone' and 'Game Over' (reminds me of oldskool Doctor Who music)." -X.Nihilo (voice of Kiss)
